from pathlib import Path
import json, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
original=(work/'input.groups.svg').read_text()
root=ET.fromstring(original)
parent=next(e for e in root.iter() if e.get('id')=='collar-silhouette')
outer=parent.get('d').split('M ')[1]
points=[(float(x),float(y)) for x,y in re.findall(r'([0-9.]+),([0-9.]+)',outer)]
# Keep the bound guide's shoulder/side contour, including its original conversion margin.
# Only the arch behind the neck and the bottom hidden by the upper body are simplified.
start=points.index((140.5,400.0))
left=points.index((307.5,254.0))
right=next(i for i in range(350,len(points)) if points[i][0]>=454.5)
end=points.index((619.5,400.0))
xy=lambda p:f'{p[0]:g},{p[1]:g}'
commands=['M '+xy(points[start])]+['L '+xy(p) for p in points[start+1:left+1]]
commands+=['C 332,243 356,238 380,238',f'C 404,238 430,245 {xy(points[right])}']
commands+=['L '+xy(p) for p in points[right+1:end+1]]
commands+=['C 520,401 241,401 140.5,400 Z']
d=' '.join(commands)
back_desc='后领位于颈部、肩部与上身后方；保留两肩可见外缘，以平滑宽拱跨过颈后，底边延至 y=400，为颈部转动及肩部相对位移后的领口露出留余量。'
back=f'<g id="collar--collar_back" data-part-path="collar/collar_back"><desc>{back_desc}</desc><path id="collar--collar_back-silhouette" d="{d}" fill="#769ead" stroke="none" /></g>'
body_tag='<g id="upper_body" data-group-path="upper_body">'
assert original.count(body_tag)==1
candidate=original.replace(body_tag,back+body_tag,1)
front_tag='<g id="collar--collar_front" data-part-path="collar/collar_front">'
assert candidate.count(front_tag)==1
candidate=candidate.replace(front_tag,front_tag+'<desc>前领既有闭合底形覆盖完整，外缘及 V 形开口保持原样；颈后和肩后露出由同级 collar_back 独立承接。</desc>',1)
(work/'candidate.svg').write_text(candidate)
patch={'groups':[],'parts':[{'name':'collar_back','note':'衣领后片，独立置于颈部、肩部和上身后方；宽拱跨过颈后并延至肩后，承接转颈和相对摆动的露出，沿用父稿两肩外缘。'}]}
(work/'children.json').write_text(json.dumps(patch,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('candidate:',work/'candidate.svg')
print('hidden arch joins:',points[left],points[right])

from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, re, os, shutil, xml.etree.ElementTree as E

node=root/'refinement/groups/collar/2.直属拆分与色块/2.3.运动露出补齐'
work=node/'work'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
baseline=json.loads((work/'input-hashes.json').read_text())
for p,h in baseline.items():
    assert sha(root/p)==h, f'Input changed before delivery: {p}'
assert sha(work/'input.groups.svg')==baseline['block-layers/groups.svg']
assert sha(work/'input.groups.json')==baseline['structure/groups.json']
old=E.parse(work/'input.groups.svg').getroot()
new=E.parse(work/'candidate.svg').getroot()
assert old.attrib==new.attrib
old_ids={e.get('id'):e for e in old.iter() if e.get('id')}
new_ids={e.get('id'):e for e in new.iter() if e.get('id')}
assert len(new_ids)==sum(bool(e.get('id')) for e in new.iter())
assert set(new_ids)-set(old_ids)=={'collar--collar_back','collar--collar_back-silhouette'}
for identity,element in old_ids.items():
    assert new_ids[identity].attrib==element.attrib, f'Existing geometry/attributes changed: {identity}'
    if identity!='collar--collar_front':
        assert E.tostring(element)==E.tostring(new_ids[identity]), f'Existing component changed: {identity}'
back=new_ids['collar--collar_back']
assert back.get('data-part-path')=='collar/collar_back'
path=new_ids['collar--collar_back-silhouette']
assert re.fullmatch(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}',path.get('fill',''))
assert path.get('fill') not in {e.get('fill') for e in old.iter()}
assert path.get('stroke')=='none' and path.get('d').rstrip().endswith('Z')
assert len([e for e in back if e.tag.endswith('path')])==1
order=[e.get('id') for e in new]
assert order.index('collar')<order.index('collar--collar_back')<order.index('upper_body')<order.index('upper_body--neck')<order.index('collar--collar_front')
patch=json.loads((work/'children.json').read_text())
assert patch['groups']==[] and [p['name'] for p in patch['parts']]==['collar_back']
tree=json.loads((work/'candidate.groups.json').read_text())
assert next(g for g in tree['groups'] if g['name']=='collar')['parts']==[{'name':'collar_front'},*patch['parts']]
report=json.loads((work/'bounds-check.json').read_text())
assert report['status']=='pass' and len(report['results'])==2
assert all(r['outside_samples']==0 for r in report['results'])
with Image.open(work/'candidate-preview.png') as im:
    assert im.size==(760,650) and im.mode=='RGB'
    assert all(im.getpixel(p)==(255,255,255) for p in [(0,0),(759,0),(0,649),(759,649)])

# Promote the exact inspected draft and its checked patch/report, keeping the baseline and draft.
deliveries=[(work/'candidate.svg',root/'block-layers/groups.svg'),
            (work/'candidate-preview.png',root/'block-layers/preview.png'),
            (work/'children.json',node/'children.json'),
            (work/'bounds-check.json',node/'轮廓检查.json')]
for index,(src,dst) in enumerate(deliveries):

    shutil.copyfile(src,staging)
    os.replace(staging,dst)
    assert sha(src)==sha(dst)
assert sha(root/'structure/groups.json')==baseline['structure/groups.json']
assert sha(root/'references/reference.png')==baseline['references/reference.png']

}
